newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain plays down diplomatic crisis with Cuba.
newsitem.headline: Spain plays down diplomatic crisis with Cuba.

text.p: Spain said on Friday its diplomatic spat with Cuba was "under control" and "We expect the tension will slowly diminish."

The conservatives who won power in Spain six months ago have repeatedly criticised Fidel Castro's communist government. Havana accused Madrid this week of "flagrant interference" and withdrew its approval for a new Spanish ambassador.
But government spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez told reporters after the weekly cabinet meeting that "The matter is under control and everything is calm."
"Spanish interests in Cuba have not been damaged in any way," he said.
